name: Dragonborn
flavor_rewritten: Born of draconic blood, this one speaks with a furnace in its chest and can spend that fire in a single devastating exhale.

name: Dwarf
flavor_rewritten: Raised beneath the mountains, this stone-sense reader spots hidden workings in carved rock and shrugs off rot that would fell others.

name: Elf
flavor_rewritten: Old magic threads through elven nerve and blood: sharper senses against tricks and traps, and a fickle immunity to being lulled or frozen by fear.

name: Gnome
flavor_rewritten: Small hands, restless ideas. A gnome packs one more pouch of swig and gadget than anyone else can carry, and brews its own bargains.

name: Goliath
flavor_rewritten: Hewn from highland granite and stubbornness: thrown weapons leave the hand on strength, and once in a lifetime the mountain simply refuses to fall.

name: Halfling
flavor_rewritten: Fortune favors the small. Three times on every floor, a halfling's unlucky hand gets a second spin and keeps whichever fate lands kinder.

name: Human

ability_bonuses.note: +1 to two abilities of the player's choice

flavor_rewritten: The jack-of-all-trades: no single gift, but a head start at mastering one more knack than anyone else picks up for free.

name: Orc
flavor_rewritten: A reputation walks in front of an orc: bigger prey gets hit harder, and lesser foes think twice before leaping at sight.

name: Tiefling
flavor_rewritten: Hellfire sits politely in the bloodline: a pocket of flame the tiefling can snap out at will, free of any spellbook's price.

name: Aasimar
flavor_rewritten: A shard of celestial dawn: once per floor the aasimar can let it flare, burning every curse off the body and mending a little of what it left behind.
